source-integrity.provenance: SEC 10-Q/shareholder letter anchor operations; independent market reporting separated
source-integrity.freshness: Q2 primary evidence August 6 and valuation context September 19
source-integrity.duplicateOriginCollapse: issuer-family materials not counted as independent corroboration
source-integrity.sourceIndependence: independent valuation is separated from issuer claims
source-integrity.rawDerivedConsistency: growth/profitability retained alongside faster marketing growth, regulation and multi-class governance limits

company-underwriting.financialOperatingTrajectory: Q2 revenue about $3.6B, nights/experiences 148.3M (+9% YoY), adjusted EBITDA $816M; asset-light model remains profitable.
company-underwriting.balanceSheet: Strong net cash supports product investment and buybacks without near-term external financing dependence.
company-underwriting.customersContracts: Two-sided marketplace demand is broad and geographically diversified rather than backlog driven.
company-underwriting.governanceCapitalAllocation: Execution improved, but multi-class voting limits outside influence and newer initiative returns remain unproven.
company-underwriting.pricingPowerConcentration: Network liquidity supports monetization, but hotels/OTAs/direct channels constrain take-rate power.
company-underwriting.catalysts: International penetration, host tools, Services/Experiences and AI support efficiency.

thesisQuality.basis: Large global two-sided network, booking growth and profitable asset-light value capture support a durable marketplace thesis.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Revenue, bookings and EBITDA show profitable growth while marketing efficiency remains a watch item.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Independent reporting shows a meaningful execution premium balancing strong quality with downside sensitivity.

catalystScore.basis: International expansion and Services/Experiences are credible catalysts but less discrete than contracted backlog.

governancePower.basis: Execution is credible, but multi-class voting and uncertain newer-initiative returns keep evidence mixed.

alignment2036.basis: Distributed lodging/services and global mobility are durable human needs, though not foundational critical infrastructure.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Trust, payments and marketplace infrastructure can be reused across stays, Services, Experiences and geographies.

bottleneckControl.basis: Network density, trust and matching create advantages, but hotels, OTAs and direct channels remain alternatives.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Asset-light global supply and geographic breadth provide flexibility, offset by cyclicality and local regulation.

substitutionResilience.basis: Network and trust infrastructure create moderate barriers while hotels, OTAs and direct channels remain substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Distributed host supply avoids concentrated physical production dependencies, though local regulation can remove supply.

pricingPower.basis: Marketplace liquidity and high gross margin support monetization, but competition limits exceptional take-rate power.

riskEvidence.basis: Regulation, cyclicality, marketing efficiency, substitution and valuation are moderated by profitability and network scale.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Current SEC and shareholder-letter evidence cover operations/economics with independent valuation context; newer-product returns remain uncertain.

scoreRecord.thesis: Airbnb's global asset-light network and trust/payments stack create durable marketplace economics, with upside dependent on sustaining booking growth and extending the network efficiently.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Regulation or competition can constrain supply while premium valuation leaves limited tolerance for slower growth.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Next earnings evidence on international growth, Services/Experiences adoption and margin efficiency.

contradictions.claim: Strong network/profitability versus marketing growth faster than nights growth.
contradictions.resolution: Both retained; economics are strong but incremental acquisition efficiency remains a watch item.

unknowns.item: Long-run returns from Services/Experiences and market-by-market regulatory impacts remain uncertain.
